headline: Uzbekistan assesses Iraqi ports as international freight shipping transit points
summary: Uzbekistan expressed interest in utilizing Iraqi ports as transit hubs for commercial goods following transport ministry discussions on international road freight agreements.
why: Central Asian landlocked economies seek alternative sea access routes. Iraqi port usage alters trade corridors between Central Asia and the Middle East.

impacts.name: Iraq
impacts.why: Positioning ports as Uzbek transit points boosts regional shipping hub activity.
impacts.baseline_rule: first recorded price at or after created_at (15-minute price recorder); end = first price at least 24 h later, within 48 h
